target: Shared Fleet footer extension with project strip and Ask AI

contract.purpose: Give product visitors one compact way to ask their preferred AI about the current product and discover related public work.
contract.canonicalPurpose: The shared footer helps a visitor understand the current product through a pre-filled AI handoff and continue into related public projects without another account or backend.
contract.audience: Visitors who have reached the end of a Fleet product page and want either a concise explanation or another relevant project.
contract.job: Preserve the authored footer, then offer one clear AI handoff and one quiet portfolio discovery path.
contract.thesis: A restrained utility dock and colophon should feel inherited from the host, not like a second marketing footer.
contract.system: CurrentColor surfaces and borders, host typography, a compact split row above 760px, stacked groups below it, 44px AI actions, and a reduced-motion-safe project rail.
contract.signature: The product-specific Ask AI dock sits beside a living, self-excluding strip of the maker's other projects.
contract.risk: Two global surfaces can become repetitive or visually overpower the host, so the composition is bounded to one shallow extension with a single outer boundary.

projectCheck.command: pnpm exec vitest run tests/showcase/public-surface.test.ts && pnpm build:showcase && git diff --check

findings: The horizontally clipped project sequence is intentional on touch layouts and remains scrollable; it is not document overflow.

ownerFeedback.note: The owner required both footer surfaces on every applicable project and explicitly delegated implementation without feedback pauses.
